name: Multiplex / Organizational Model
description: Several relationship layers over shared entities. Organizational studies and social or institutional mappings.
reference_use_case: Organizational studies and social or institutional mappings.
integrity_rule: Avoid collapsing relationships from different layers.
antipattern: Do not collapse distinct temporal, institutional or role relationships into one universal graph.
design_question: Which layer owns each relationship and at what time?
situational_schema: People, roles, institutions and resources are mapped in distinguishable relationship layers.
